subject: Proposal: MAP-triggered rebate schedule & evaluation milestones
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.z@brightlens.ai>, Jake Miller <jake.miller@brightlens.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-05T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: MAP-triggered rebate schedule & evaluation milestones

Emily / Jake —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass MAP that links commercial concessions (rebates / discounts) to concrete evaluation checkpoints so we align incentives while protecting Redwood on commit timing. Highlights in this package: 

- Evaluation plan: 6-week tech eval with three checkpoints (Wk2, Wk4, Wk6) and deliverables specified for each checkpoint.
- Commercial mechanics: conditional rebates applied at each checkpoint if BrightLens signs the initial commit and reaches usage ramp targets. Proposed tiers: 10% rebate at checkpoint 2 (Wk4) if P0 latency and token quality targets met; 15% at checkpoint 3 (Wk6) if sustained throughput + 3-month commit; 20% backstop rebate if customer converts to Dedicated capacity within 90 days and meets a 90% utilization threshold.
- Pricing schedule (attached): shows list price, committed uplift discounts, and milestone rebate accounting.

Ask: review the attached MAP_v1 and pricing_schedule_v2 and confirm any items that procurement/legal will need for a DocuSign-ready packet. If acceptable, we can lock the 30-day signature window for the expedited rebate.

Attachments: BrightLens_MAP_v1.pdf, pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhang <emily.z@brightlens.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Miller <jake.miller@brightlens.ai>
Date: 2027-04-05T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: MAP-triggered rebate schedule & evaluation milestones

Vivek —

Appreciate the clear layout. A few quick questions from procurement/legal and from our engineering lead: 

1) Can you clarify whether the rebates are applied as a credit on future invoices or as an upfront price reduction once the checkpoint is validated? We prefer credits applied after confirmation.
2) The 90-day conversion requirement for the backstop rebate might be tight for our procurement cycle. Can we push that to 120 days?
3) Who validates the checkpoint deliverables? We need a short SOW clause identifying the reviewers on both sides (we propose BrightLens engineering lead + Redwood's Solutions Architect).

Also, timeline: if we get a DocuSign link this week, Legal says they can turn the standard T&Cs in ~5 business days. Can you add a target signature date in the MAP?

Thanks — I’ll share this with our finance/ops.

—Emily
Emily Zhang, Director of Platform, BrightLens AI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.z@brightlens.ai>, Jake Miller <jake.miller@brightlens.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: MAP-triggered rebate schedule & evaluation milestones

Emily — thanks, good questions. Short answers inline below, then an updated attachment.

1) Rebates: we invoice at list/committed pricing during the eval/pilot. Rebates are issued as invoice credits applied retroactively once the checkpoint is validated (we’ll issue a credit memo on the next billing cycle). I noted this in section 4 of the attached pricing_schedule_v3.xlsx.
2) 120 days for the backstop conversion is reasonable — I updated the MAP to 120 days.
3) Validation: agreed — BrightLens engineering lead + Redwood Solutions Architect (Marissa) will jointly sign off on checkpoint acceptance. Added a 48-hour window to dispute measurements before credit issuance.

I attached pricing_schedule_v3.xlsx and an example eval_results_sample.csv template we’ll use to record checkpoint metrics. I also added a target signature date: 2027-05-05 to give both sides time for legal review; if you want an accelerated 30-day path we can carve out an early-sign incentive.

Attachment notes: 
- pricing_schedule_v3.xlsx (see tabs: list_price, commit_discounts, rebate_ledger)
- eval_results_sample.csv (metric templates we’ll use for Wk2/Wk4/Wk6)

If that looks good I’ll ask Legal to prepare a DocuSign packet and we can reflect the final redlines.

Best,
Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-06T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Fw: Proposal: MAP-triggered rebate schedule & evaluation milestones

Internal note —

Vivek, Rishi — quick negotiation play: BrightLens signals procurement friction on the 120d vs our standard 90d backstop. Suggest we: 

- Offer to keep the 120d in the MAP but accelerate the first rebate (10% at Wk4) to be payable within 30 days of checkpoint sign-off if they sign the DocuSign packet within 30 days of our DocuSign send. That gives a short-term win for the customer while protecting our long-term incentive.
- Keep a clause limiting aggregate rebates to X% of first-year committed spend (we should pick 25% cap).

If you approve, I’ll incorporate those concessions into the final redline and push Legal to include the payment mechanics as credit memos.

—Marissa
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhang <emily.z@brightlens.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Miller <jake.miller@brightlens.ai>
Date: 2027-04-07T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: MAP-triggered rebate schedule & evaluation milestones

Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks — the updates look reasonable. We accept the following: 

- Rebates as invoice credits post-validation (per pricing_schedule_v3).
- 120-day conversion window for the backstop rebate.
- Early-sign incentive: 10% rebate payout accelerated to 30 days if DocuSign signed within 30 days of send.
- Please add the aggregate rebate cap (25% of year-1 committed spend) into the DocuSign packet.

Please send the DocuSign when you have the final redline; we’ll route to procurement and aim to complete within 5 business days of receiving the packet.

DocuSign readiness: happy to receive the packet at the link below.
https://redwood.app/docusign/packet/7f3b9d

—Emily
